messages:
elaine: quick mock — adding SLO presets above the min/max controls so people can pick a profile before tuning. https://img.redwood/mock/slo-presets.png :eyes:
omar: i like presets. can we name them less marketing-y? e.g. 'latency-first', 'balanced', 'cost-optimized' instead of 'fast & cheap'
kai: agree on names. also UX nit: presets change the SLO slider values but the slider thumb jumps without a toast — feels jarring
elaine: good call. add a small transient confirmation: 'Preset applied — review sliders' (400ms fade)
sam: pool search: the dropdown currently lists 20 GPUs, but no type badges. suggest "a100-40gb" / "rtx6000" badges and a tiny filter input at top
marta: Accessibility: badges are color-only. need text labels and >=4.5:1 contrast. also keyboard should open search with / or focus + type
omar: re: min/max steppers — step size is 1 GPU. for large pools that jumps too slowly. propose adaptive stepper: +1 for <10, +5 for 10-50, +10 for >50
kai: adaptive stepper seems smart. but we should show exact step size in hover tooltip so power users know what to expect
elaine: burst control: users confused about "burst minutes" vs "burst capacity". copy suggestion: "Burst capacity (temporary extra GPUs) — minutes allowed: 0–60"
sam: add guardrail callout when burst + min/max would allow > total project quota. callout text: "This configuration may exceed your quota. Apply will reserve capacity and may incur charges."
marta: keyboard/accessibility for SLO slider: allow arrow keys to nudge small, PageUp/PageDown for larger jumps, and aria-live to announce value changes
omar: small code snippet for preset payload for backend (for devs):
```
POST /api/v1/presets/apply
{
  "preset": "latency-first",
  "overrides": {"min_gpus": 2}
}
```

elaine: thanks — design-bot, can you generate updated mock with the adaptive stepper, filter input, preset toast and the new copy?
design-bot: created update 1719800030 — https://figma.redwood/flow/1719800030 :white_check_mark:
kai: UX question: where do we land users when they click "learn more" on SLO presets? prefer an inline mini-panel instead of full doc page
sam: +1 inline panel with short bullets and a link to full docs for advanced config
elaine: final callouts: 1) make pool badges text-first for contrast 2) show estimated monthly cost delta when enabling burst (small estimate) 3) add undo toast after apply for 10s
omar: thumbs: :thumbsup: can we A/B test 'preset-first' vs 'controls-first' in product flag?
elaine: yes will flag it. thanks everyone — I'll push updated comps and copy after lunch
elaine: (edit) attaching suggested copy snippets: "Latency-first: prioritizes low tail latency with higher min capacity." "Cost-optimized: keeps low min, increases cache/batching settings."
marta: noted — I'll run an accessibility check once the comps land
elaine: closing thread once figs are updated. thanks :rocket:
